page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Running head at the top with the page number at the top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Pulcerrima est ἀδόπολια[?], qua Deum stantem, & ueluti decempeda terram Cananaan secundum numerum tribuum Israelis in certas prouincias dimetientem & diuidentem: ac solo aspectu, Gentes perterrefacientem: & tam mœtanam & colliculosam, quàm campestrem regionem, sibi suisque subijcientem: loca denique multis seculis, ut uidebantur, inaccessa, patefacientem, Propheta introducit.
Sit hoc tertium Dei μεγαλεῖον & κατροφωμα[?], quod fanè multis in locis ueteris Testamenti ualde celebratur.

Deus, qui transfert & stabilit reges, Dan.2.21. & qui condidit ex uno sanguine omne genus hominum, ut habitarent per uniuersam superficiem terrae, definitis tempestiuitatibus quas praestituit, & positis terminis habitationis eorum, ut quaererent Deum,&c.Act.17.26. extirpatis & deletis Cananaeis, distribuit illorū prouincias populo Israel secundum tribus XII.[?]ufus ad eam rem administro Iofua & alijs praestantibus uiris.
Quare fatendum est, hunc populum, velut eximium Dei opus, peculiariter ei curae esse.

page.notes: The Greek words in the first two paragraphs are uncertain: "ἀδόπολια" (first line) and "κατροφωμα" (second paragraph) are marked [?]. The printed Greek is small and partly worn, so the letters are approximate. "XII.[?]ufus" after "tribus" is unclear in the scan; the word following "XII" may read differently. The text at "Dan.2.21." and "Act.17.26." is printed inline and kept as is. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The printed page number is 311 and the running head includes "III." as printed.
